'''Amber earrings''' are [[jewelry]] that slowly heal the wearer. Worn in the head slot, they give constant {{MCW|Regeneration}} I. In Matcha Flavoured, where there is no [[natural regeneration]], they are one of the few ways to regain health without eating.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
The [[Jeweler]] sells amber earrings at Journeyman level for 8 [[Obol]]s and one [[Amber]]. The trade can be used 999 times.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/3/amber_earrings.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Effect ===
Every tick, if the wearer has no Regeneration effect, the earrings give 3 seconds of Regeneration I with no particles. As soon as one application runs out, the next begins, so the wearer regenerates continuously. If the player already has Regeneration from another source, such as [[food]], the earrings don't replace it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/regeneration.mcfunction}}</ref> Regeneration I heals whenever its remaining duration is a multiple of 50 ticks, so each 3-second application heals {{Hp|1}} once: about {{Hp|1}} every 3 seconds.

=== Armor ===
Amber earrings are worn in the head slot and take the place of a helmet. They give 1 [[armor]] point and no armor toughness or knockback resistance. Like all jewelry, they are unbreakable and, being built on a netherite helmet, don't burn in fire or lava. See [[Jewelry]].
